segments.text: Queſt. 125th. Which is the fourth Petition?

Anſ.
"GIVE US THIS DAY OUR DAILY BREAD; That is, be pleaſed to provide us with all Things neceſſary for the Body, that we may thereby acknowledge Thee to be the only Fountain of all Good, and that neither our Care nor Induſtry nor even Thy Gifts, can profit us without Thy Bleſſing and therefore that we may withdraw our Truſt from all Creatures, and place it alone in Thee.
